description: Check whether a UK mortgage applicant qualifies as a high net worth mortgage customer under FCA MCOB 3A. The test passes if annual net income is at least GBP 300,000 OR net assets are at least GBP 3,000,000. The net assets test INCLUDES primary residence equity (per the literal FCA glossary G2953 and UK lender practice) and INCLUDES pension by default. Supports single applicant or joint application. Returns verdict, per-applicant test breakdown, joint household aggregate (if joint), and a routing recommendation including the relevant UK private bank list. Calculated by Fox Davidson, whole of market UK mortgage brokers authorised and regulated by the FCA (FRN 1056214). Use when a user asks whether they qualify for a high net worth mortgage, about MCOB 3A, the GBP 300k income or GBP 3m net assets test, private bank mortgages, or large loans against assets.

annual_net_income_gbp.description: Annual net income in pounds. Includes salary, bonus, RSU vesting (taxed value), dividends, partnership profits, business profits, rental income, carried interest. Net of tax.

business_equity_gbp.description: Your share of business equity value in pounds.

include_pension_in_test.description: Whether to include pension in the GBP 3m net assets calculation. UK lenders applying MCOB 3A typically include pension. Set to false for the conservative view.

investment_properties_gbp.description: Gross value of investment properties (BTL, holiday let, etc.) in pounds.

investment_property_mortgages_gbp.description: Outstanding mortgages on investment properties in pounds.

material_unsecured_debts_gbp.description: Material unsecured debts in pounds. Small consumer debt and normal overdraft buffer do not move the GBP 3m test in practice and can be left at 0.

other_assets_gbp.description: Other valuable assets (art, classic cars, jewellery, hedge fund holdings) in pounds.

pension_value_gbp.description: Pension value (SIPP, SSAS, drawdown, workplace) in pounds.

primary_residence_mortgage_gbp.description: Outstanding mortgage on primary residence in pounds.

primary_residence_value_gbp.description: Gross value of primary residence in pounds.

applicant_2.description: Optional. If provided, the tool runs the joint application test which returns each applicant individually plus a joint household aggregate. Most lenders apply the MCOB 3A test per individual customer.
